concepts.name: Relation
concepts.simple_definition: A relation is a set of ordered pairs representing a correspondence between elements of two sets.
concepts.deep_explanation: Mathematically, a relation R from set A to set B is a subset of the Cartesian product A × B. If (x,y) ∈ R, we say x is related to y.
concepts.real_example: Let A = {1, 2} and B = {3, 4}. A relation R = {(1, 3), (2, 4)} represents a one-to-one mapping.
concepts.common_confusion: Students often confuse a general relation with a function. Not all relations are functions.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ግንኙነት ማለት በሁለት ስብስቦች አባላት መካከል ያለውን ተዛምዶ የሚገልጽ የተገመዱ ጥንዶች ስብስብ ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: በሂሳብ ትርጓሜ፣ ከስብስብ A ወደ ስብስብ B የሚደረግ ግንኙነት R የካርቴዢያን ብዜት A × B ንዑስ ስብስብ ነው።
concepts.real_example_amharic: ለምሳሌ A = {1, 2} እና B = {3, 4} ቢሆኑ፣ ግንኙነት R = {(1, 3), (2, 4)} የአንድ ለአንድ ተዛምዶን ያሳያል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: ተማሪዎች ብዙ ጊዜ ግንኙነትን (Relation) ከፈንክሽን (Function) ጋር ያደናግራሉ። ሁሉም ግንኙነቶች ፈንክሽን አይደሉም።

concepts.name: Function
concepts.simple_definition: A function is a relation in which each element of the domain is mapped to exactly one element of the range.
concepts.deep_explanation: For a relation to be a function, no two distinct ordered pairs can have the same first coordinate. This is tested graphically using the vertical line test.
concepts.real_example: y = 2x + 1 is a function because for every input x, there is a unique output y.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking that x² + y² = 1 is a function. It is a circle, and fails the vertical line test.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ፈንክሽን ማለት በእያንዳንዱ የዶሜን አባል ላይ አንድ እና አንድ የሬንጅ አባል ብቻ የሚያዛምድ ግንኙነት ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: አንድ ግንኙነት ፈንክሽን ለመሆን በማንኛውም ሁለት ጥንዶች ውስጥ የመጀመሪያው ቅንጅት ተመሳሳይ መሆን የለበትም። ይህ በቁም መስመር መፈተኛ (vertical line test) ይረጋገጣል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: y = 2x + 1 ፈንክሽን ነው፤ ምክንያቱም ለእያንዳንዱ የ x እሴት አንድ የ y እሴት ብቻ ስላለው።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: x² + y² = 1 ፈንክሽን ነው ብሎ ማሰብ ስህተት ነው። ይህ የክበብ ቀመር ሲሆን የቁም መስመር መፈተኛን አያልፍም።

concepts.name: Relations And Functions 3 A Pattern Is A
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 1: Relations and Functions 3 A pattern is a regularity in the world in human-made design or in abstract ideas
concepts.deep_explanation: As such, the elements of a pattern repeat in a predictable manner
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Relations and Functions 3 A pattern is a from page 12.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Relations and Functions 3 A pattern is a with adjacent topics in Chapter 1.
concepts.name_amharic: Relations and Functions 3 A pattern is a (በአማርኛ)
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Unit 1: Relations and Functions 3 A pattern is a regularity in the world in human-made design or in abstract ideas (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] As such, the elements of a pattern repeat in a predictable manner — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 12 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: Relations And Functions 4 The Sequences
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 1: Relations and Functions 4 the sequences are based on the addition or subtraction of the terms
concepts.deep_explanation: If two or more terms in the sequence are given, we can use addition or subtraction to find the arithmetic pattern
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Relations and Functions 4 the sequences  from page 13.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Relations and Functions 4 the sequences  with adjacent topics in Chapter 1.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Unit 1: Relations and Functions 4 the sequences are based on the addition or subtraction of the terms (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] If two or more terms in the sequence are given, we can use addition or subtraction to find the arithmetic pattern — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 13 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
